MARA, a Leading Listed Bitcoin Miner, Sells $1.1 Billion in BTC as Revenue Falls 35% MARA, one of the world's largest publicly traded Bitcoin mining companies, disclosed in its Q3 2026 earnings that it sold 13,597 BTC after quarter-end at an average price of $81,039, raising approximately $1.1 billion. The proceeds were used to fully repay $750 million in Bitcoin-backed loans, releasing 17,477 BTC previously pledged as collateral. Q3 revenue fell 35% year-over-year to $164.2 million, while net income reached $632 million, largely driven by $885 million in digital asset fair-value gains. As of September 30, MARA held 34,012 BTC, down 36% year-over-year, and mined 2,247 BTC during the quarter, up 5%. — link

56 of 62 Firms Oppose OKXICE Tokenized Stock Plan; All Six Remaining Are Crypto-Linked Robinhood confirmed it does not object to its shares trading on OKXICE, a planned tokenized stock trading platform jointly owned by crypto exchange OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE). It joins Securitize and BitGo as the third company to explicitly take that position. Of the 62 companies initially selected, 56 (about 90%) have filed objections, leaving just six without publicly disclosed opposition: Robinhood, Securitize, BitGo, Circle, Coinbase and Strategy, all closely tied to the crypto industry. — link

Highlight Clip: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum's Remaining Roadmap Could Take 20 Years Without AI Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum's Remaining Roadmap Could Take 20 Years Without AI On Nov 4, 2026, Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin told Moneycontrol that lean Ethereum is a set of upgrades Ethereum will push over the next few years, aiming to use zero-knowledge proofs and AI as widely as possible. He said such techniques were once kept in the application layer because the base layer carried too much risk, but the technology has now matured. With AI, he added, they can move much faster, especially AI-assisted formal verification that checks whether new code is safe. — link

Upbit to List HYPE Token of World's Largest Decentralized Perpetuals Exchange Upbit, South Korea's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, announced it will list HYPE, the native token of Hyperliquid, the world's largest decentralized perpetual futures exchange by trading volume. Trading will begin on November 10 at 15:00 KST (06:00 UTC) across KRW, BTC and USDT markets. Bithumb , South Korea's second-largest cryptocurrency exchange, announced it will list Hyperliquid (HYPE) and Collector Crypt (CARDS) in its KRW market on November 10. HYPE trading is scheduled to begin at 07:00 UTC, with deposits supported via HyperEVM, while CARDS trading is expected to start at 09:00 UTC, with deposits supported via Solana. — link
